Preparing your share….context: Title shown while the shared content is read.

Saver is reading the shared content..text: Saver is reading the shared content.
Saver is reading the shared content..context: Text shown while the shared content is read.

Cancel.context: Toolbar button that closes the share sheet without saving.

Save as.context: Header above the choice between Task and Bookmark, and the accessibility label of that choice.

Task.context: Option and card title: save the shared content as a task.

Bookmark.context: Option and card title: save the shared content as a bookmark.

Save to.context: Header above the space the item is saved to.

Current Space.context: Shown as the destination when Saver has not shared its list of spaces yet.

Save to list.context: Header above the task list the new task is saved to.

Save to folder.context: Header above the bookmark folder the new bookmark is saved to.

No List.context: Option of the list picker: save the task outside of any list.

No Folder.context: Option of the folder picker: save the bookmark outside of any folder.

What needs doing?.context: Placeholder of the task title field.

%lld/%lld characters.context: Counter under the task title field. Phrase it so it works for any number, e.g. “Characters: 12/1000”.

Title.context: Placeholder of the bookmark title field.

Website address (optional).context: Placeholder of the bookmark's web address field.

New Task.context: Title given to a task when the shared content has no text.

New Bookmark.context: Title given to a bookmark when the shared content has no title or address.

Save Task.context: Toolbar button that saves the shared content as a task.

Save Bookmark.context: Toolbar button that saves the shared content as a bookmark.

Remind me.context: Switch that adds a reminder to the new task or bookmark.

Reminder style.context: Label of the segmented control that chooses between a one-time and a repeating reminder.

One-time.context: Reminder style option: the reminder goes off once, at a date and time.

Repeating.context: Reminder style option: the reminder repeats on selected weekdays.

Reminder time.context: Label of the reminder's date and time picker.

Choose at least one weekday..context: Hint under the weekday buttons of a repeating reminder when none is selected.

Sound.context: Switch of the reminder: play a sound when it goes off.

Important.context: Switch of the reminder: deliver it as a Time Sensitive notification.

Time Sensitive notifications can appear.text: Time Sensitive notifications can appear during Focus.
Time Sensitive notifications can appear.context: Explanation under the Important switch. “Time Sensitive” and “Focus” are iOS feature names; use the names iOS uses in your language.

Time Sensitive notifications are disable.text: Time Sensitive notifications are disabled. Important reminders will still be delivered normally.
Time Sensitive notifications are disable.context: Explanation under the Important switch when Time Sensitive notifications are turned off for Saver. Use the iOS name for Time Sensitive notifications.

Checking notification access….context: Shown while Saver asks for permission to send notifications.

Notifications are off. The item and remi.text: Notifications are off. The item and reminder will still be saved.
Notifications are off. The item and remi.context: Warning when Saver may not send notifications.

Saver couldn’t confirm notification acce.text: Saver couldn’t confirm notification access. The item and reminder will still be saved.
Saver couldn’t confirm notification acce.context: Warning when the notification permission could not be checked.

Saved to Saver.context: Title shown after the item was saved.

Saved to your current space..context: Text shown after saving when the space is not known.

Reminder scheduled..context: Shown after saving when the reminder was scheduled.

Reminder saved. Enable notifications in.text: Reminder saved. Enable notifications in Settings to receive it.
Reminder saved. Enable notifications in.context: Shown after saving when notifications are off.

Reminder saved, but it couldn’t be sched.text: Reminder saved, but it couldn’t be scheduled right now.
Reminder saved, but it couldn’t be sched.context: Shown after saving when the reminder could not be scheduled.

Couldn’t Save.context: Title shown when the share could not be read or saved.

Try Again.context: Button that tries to read or save the share again.
